audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Kalista's Oathsworn ally is untargetable through the Fate's Call dash, and nothing on the page currently says so — dontsFull[1] talks about R timing but never mentions the untargetable window, so a reader could still dump Buster Shot into a dash that can't be hit.
audit.why: R-Fate's Call teleports the ally to Kalista and the ally becomes untargetable during that dash — a Buster Shot fired into it whiffs. Documented in missingInteractions for this matchup.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states the Oathsworn is untargetable through the dash and to wait it out before committing R.

edits.before: Contest level 1 autos — your early range is real and the all-in threat starts at 2; set the tone.
edits.after: Her Passive hop-attacks and Q-Pierce poke beat your level 1 before W-Rocket Jump is up — play for safe CS, not the trade.

edits.before: Jump-bomb all-ins open: W in off any support CC and the E detonation math is already rude.
edits.after: Her Passive mobility keeps her hopping while she stacks Rend on you — she's never standing still for your E-Explosive Charge.

edits.before: Full kit: E the target, stack it with autos, and R the finish — the lane's most honest kill threat.
edits.after: She still kites your W-Rocket Jump at range and rips Rend off for burst before you can land the full string.

edits.before: Trade around the bomb: four stacks detonate — back off at three or commit at four; never linger between.
edits.after: Sentinel hops keep her out of your all-in range through levels 4-5 — she dictates when the trade happens, not you.

edits.before: His tools answer one jump — bait them with bomb threat, then jump the cooldown with the real string.

edits.before: Jump first into a held answer. Waste R on spaced poke. Trade at range against his tools. The R buys fights, not poke — spend it like the last one in stock.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: Fate's Call is down 160s at rank 1, 120s at max — inside that gap she has no support-toss engage or escape, so that's when your jump-bomb string is safest to commit.

edits.before: The jump resets ONLY on takedowns and full stacks — entering without either plan is a one-way trip.
edits.after: The Oathsworn ally is untargetable through the Fate's Call dash — landing Buster Shot into it whiffs. Wait the dash out before you commit everything.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: Kalista's Q-Pierce (9s cd, 1150 range) and Passive hops chip you from outside your own range — closing with W is worth more than trading autos at max range.

edits.before: - Kalista Fate’s Call: matchup-defining — The support-toss engage — respect every brush her Oathsworn could be sitting in. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rocket Jump (reset) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Kalista's R-Fate's Call is down 160s early, 120s at max rank — the support-toss engage; respect every brush her Oathsworn could be sitting in until it's back.
